meta.name: pol-probe
meta.description: Define a Proof of Life probe to test a risky hypothesis cheaply. Use when you need harsh truth before building real product.

copy.tagline: 用低成本探针验证高风险假设
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在投入开发前快速验证产品想法是否靠谱
copy.tagline_en: Validate risky hypotheses with low-cost probes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly test product ideas before building

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会引导你定义一个轻量、可丢弃的验证实验（Proof of Life probe），用来快速测试一个高风险假设，避免直接开发正式产品。它会帮你填写模板，包括假设、风险、成功标准、工具和时间线等。
howto.when: 当你需要验证一个具体假设或消除某个风险，但又不想投入大量开发资源时触发。例如，在开始构建新功能前，想低成本测试其可行性。

say.text: 帮我定义一个 PoL probe，测试餐厅经理是否会每天拍照上传发票。
say.note: Claude 会引导你填写假设、风险、成功标准等。

say.text: 为这个定价假设写一个低成本的验证实验。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude will guide you to define a lightweight, disposable validation experiment (Proof of Life probe) to quickly test a risky hypothesis without building production software. It helps you fill a template including hypothesis, risk, success criteria, tools, and timeline.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to validate a specific hypothesis or eliminate a risk without heavy development investment. For example, before building a new feature, you want to test its feasibility cheaply.

say_en.text: Define a PoL probe to test if restaurant managers will photograph invoices daily.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you through hypothesis, risk, success criteria, etc.

say_en.text: Create a low-cost validation experiment for this pricing hypothesis.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for hypothesis details and generate a full PoL probe document.
